title: Transformers
comment: The PAL release: the same size and layout as SLUS_206.68 (one 'main' section at 0x00100000, size 0x5CE480). The USA code regions fit it unchanged: each boundary has the same code or data on both sides, and the VU1 microcode between them sits at the same addresses (tools/make_vu1_grass.py's hash matches).
code_shift_comment: Where its code sits against SLUS_206.68's: [first USA address, last USA address, PAL - USA]. Between the ranges the two releases' code differs. Measured on every code address the project uses (src/game_version.h, tools/check_pal_addresses.py); the USA overrides.toml is translated with it (make_config.py).
